title: Blinded evidence-grounding calibration set
purpose: Evaluate typed path support, licensed text support, and therapeutic plausibility as separate labels rather than folding them into Recall or MRR.
annotation_basis: A small, frozen research calibration set annotated from the typed query semantics and the cited Europe PMC excerpts. It is not clinical expert consensus and must not be used as medical advice.

labels.graph_path_support: Whether the query's typed path is present in the training graph; held-out target edges are expected to be false.

annotations.rationale: The cited record names zonisamide as a treatment for epileptic seizures in dogs; the species boundary prevents a human clinical-utility claim.
The cited preclinical screen names phenytoin and reports reduced seizure probability in one model; this supports an antiseizure research relationship, not a patient-specific recommendation.
The cited preclinical screen names valproate and reports reduced seizure probability and duration in one model.
The cited record describes propofol during epilepsy surgery anesthesia; perioperative use is not evidence that propofol treats epilepsy.
The cited record concerns anesthetic selection and seizure monitoring; desflurane is not named and no therapeutic indication is established.
The cited record discusses general anesthetic pharmacology but does not name levobupivacaine or establish an epilepsy treatment relationship.
The graph path is not a licensed text record, and the frozen CC BY manifest contains no candidate-specific record for clorazepate.
The cited record is general-anesthetic class context and does not establish fospropofol as an epilepsy therapy.
